title: happy's: a concept site for a Cary cocktail bar
tag: Concept site · cocktail bar, Cary, NC
summaryLead: A concept site for a cocktail bar in downtown Cary. Not a launched project.
story: happy's is a cocktail bar and event space in downtown Cary, NC, known for a wall covered in smiley faces. This one is our own concept, made to show how that personality, a long menu and odd hours could fit on one loud, friendly page. It's a single hand-written file, with a searchable menu and a climb up the stairs to the walk up.

features.title: The smiley wall
features.text: The bar's own wall sets the hero and the cream and tomato colors.

features.title: Color-coded menu
features.text: 60 items in ten sections, with filters, search and a running tab just for fun.
features.story: Sixty items is a lot to scroll on a phone. Filters and search help you find a drink, and the tab adds up whatever you tap, like a game. It never leaves the page.

features.title: The walk up
features.text: A 3D staircase made only of CSS, in a native dialog.
features.story: The stairs are part of how the bar talks about itself, and a plain link wouldn't carry that. The climb is pure CSS, no video, and it's skipped for anyone with reduced motion on.

features.title: Reviews and rating
features.text: A 4.8 rating from 26 reviews, with highlights on colored cards.

features.title: Hours and sign-up
features.text: Hours, address, directions and an email sign-up.

features.title: On a phone
features.text: The hero, menu and hours on a phone.
